title: Patch 2.2.23 — Popol and Kupa Revamp
summary: Latest patch on Original Server (live game) as of 11 Nov 2026. Headline is the Popol and Kupa revamp: Popol can now ride Kupa to chase or escape. 6 heroes buffed, 3 nerfed, 1 revamped. Marksmen pushed back to Gold Lane, fighters back to EXP Lane.
highlights: Revamp: Popol and Kupa — ride Kupa, Kupa scales with Popol, revive fallen Kupa, stronger traps
Buffs: Xavier, Lunox, Freya, Aldous, Kaja, Melissa
System: Roam gold tuning, vision / trap changes

heroChanges.title: Revamp — Ride Kupa
changes: Popol can now ride Kupa to pursue enemies or retreat
Kupa scales with Popol's level and inherits his items
Popol can revive a fallen Kupa
Traps: stronger utility, more concurrent placements, better scaling/regen — less downtime when Kupa falls
Goal: fix lack of mobility and limited skill combo potential
heroChanges.impact: Roam / Gold Lane — more chase, more escape, stronger early traps
